description:
Use this when the user wants a clip's look changed at editor depth: "gaming-style captions", "a cinematic
grade", "a glitch at the drop", "make it square". Set only what was asked; names from edit_catalog;
also_clip_ids applies it to more clips.
Not for: caption size or color, music, silences (edit_clip) or overlays (add_to_clip). Undoable. Costs no
Horizon Units. Returns job_id for job_status.

also_clip_ids.description: Up to 49 more clip ids for the preset.

caption_box.description: Box behind captions: off, word or line.

caption_shadow.description: true adds a caption shadow, false removes it.

effect.description: Effect name from edit_catalog, or off.

effect_end_seconds.description: Effect end in seconds; 0 = clip end.

effect_start_seconds.description: Effect start, seconds into the clip, e.g. 12.5. 0 = whole clip.

filter_look.description: Color look name from edit_catalog, or off.

template.description: Saved style name or id from edit_catalog. Use alone.

template_parts.description: Parts to apply: captions, layout, headline, logo, music, overlays. Omit = all.

transition.description: Transition name from edit_catalog, used at inner cuts.

name: style_clip
title: Style a clip
